about: Outbound partner settings for course-provider links. Every provider ships at status none, so links are unchanged. Setting a provider to affiliate adds its params to its links, marks them rel="sponsored noopener" and shows a Partner link note that links to /why-its-free/. These settings never change which plans, schools or courses are shown, or their order: planning, ranking, the finder, the credits page and the plan index never read this file. The owner reviews /why-its-free/ before any provider is set to affiliate.
